common.tagline: Validate event attendance with signed QR codes.

home.title: Take attendance without paper
home.subtitle: Create an event, register your attendees and check them in from your phone, even offline.

fields.name: Name
fields.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A long passphrase is safer than a complicated password.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.checkInbox: If the email is valid, we sent you a link to verify your account. Open it to continue.

dashboard.staffEventsHint: You will check people in at these events with the scanner (coming in the next phase).

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.

attendees.name: Name

attendees.added: Guest added. Send the invitations when you are ready.

import.title: Import guests
import.intro: Upload a CSV file with name and email columns (optional: language, with es-MX or en). You can export it from Excel or Google Sheets.
import.limits: Up to {max} rows per file. You can upload several files.
import.missingColumns: We could not find the name and email columns in the first row.
import.tooMany: The file has {count} rows; the maximum is {max}.
import.empty: The file has no guest rows.
import.unreadable: We could not read the file. Save it as CSV (UTF-8) and try again.
import.ready: {count, plural, =0 {No guests ready} one {# guest ready} other {# guests ready}} to add.
import.withProblems: {count, plural, one {# row has problems} other {# rows have problems}} and will not be added.
import.submit: Add {count, plural, one {# guest} other {# guests}}
import.done: {count, plural, =0 {No guests were added.} one {# guest added.} other {# guests added.}}
import.doneHint: Review the list and send the invitations when you are ready.
import.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB. Split it into smaller files.

staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: People who will check guests in. They cannot see or edit the event's data.
staff.invited: Invitation sent. It expires in 7 days.
staff.empty: No staff for this event yet.

stats.title: Live
stats.offlineDuplicatesHint: The same person was checked in on two offline devices. The earliest check-in was kept.

purge.title: Delete attendee data
purge.reminder: This event ended more than 90 days ago. If you no longer need its guest list, delete it.
purge.hint: Permanently deletes guests, tickets, check-ins, scan history, staff and pending emails for this event. Only the event details and its totals remain. This cannot be undone. Only owners and admins can do it.
purge.closeFirst: Close registration before deleting this event's data.
